name: EPIC 248694753

text.card: A red giant 4,998 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.09 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,912 K at its surface.
